description: ASO audit of a live App Store or Google Play listing: each part (title, subtitle or short description, description, screenshots, ratings, localization) graded Working / Worth a look / Fix this with the reason, the listing's facts, and the biggest gaps. country.description: Two-letter store country (us, gb, de...). Defaults to the link's country, else us.

store_url.description: The app's App Store or Google Play link, e.g. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id570060128

name: audit_listing
title: Audit an app store listing
